user.title: SDR server (rtl_tcp)
user.description: Enter the address of the machine running rtl_tcp. No other client (SDR#, SDR++…) may be connected to the server while it is checked.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check host and port, and that no other client is connected to rtl_tcp.
error.not_rtl_tcp: The server answered but it is not rtl_tcp.
